hooks.command: if [ -f ".claude/test-passed.txt" ] && [ -f ".claude/quality-passed.txt" ] && grep -q "PASSED" ".claude/test-passed.txt" 2>/dev/null && grep -q "PASSED" ".claude/quality-passed.txt" 2>/dev/null; then rm -f ".claude/test-passed.txt" ".claude/quality-passed.txt"; echo '{"continue":true}'; else echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"🚫 推送被阻止：请先运行 gitee-agent 通过测试和质量检查"}'; fi
